title: Born at the bottom of the ocean

avatar.name: birch
avatar.design: hand-carved pale birch marionette, oversized glossy black bead eyes, visible brass pin joints, single teal knitted scarf as accent

signature_prop: small brass compass whose needle always points to the surface
notes: Example plan only. Timings are pre-narration estimates; Phase 4 retimes them to word timestamps.

chapters.label: Day one
chapters.world: station nursery and corridors, dim teal + red alarm

chapters.label: Year six
chapters.world: airlock and open seafloor, cold blue lamp light

chapters.label: Year sixteen
chapters.world: cargo sub in the trench, green instrument glow

chapters.label: Year thirty
chapters.event: station shutdown; fear of the sky (turn)

chapters.label: Year thirty-one
chapters.world: ascent from black to blue to blinding sun

shots.line: What would happen if you were born at the bottom of the ocean?
shots.environment: station medical bay, porthole full of dark water and drifting jellyfish
shots.action: newborn marionette swaddled in a hammock as a pressure alarm light pulses red

shots.line: Day one. Your first window shows no sky, only black water.
shots.environment: nursery porthole, bioluminescent jellyfish
shots.action: tiny wooden hand presses the porthole glass as a jellyfish drifts close

shots.line: The crew gives you a brass compass that always points up.
shots.environment: cramped galley, crew in grey jumpsuits
shots.action: a crew member places a brass compass in the baby's lap; the needle swings upward

shots.line: Every bolt in the walls groans when the pressure shifts.
shots.environment: steel corridor, condensation, dim teal light
shots.action: the corridor shudders, droplets fall, the hammock sways

shots.line: Year six. School is a flooded airlock and a diving suit too big.
shots.environment: airlock chamber filling with water
shots.action: child marionette in an oversized brass dive helmet waddles into rising water

shots.line: On your first swim outside, the station lights vanish behind you.
shots.environment: open seafloor, station lights fading behind
shots.action: the child swims away from the station into darkness, lamp beam cutting the water

shots.line: Something enormous passes beneath you.
shots.environment: open water, giant silhouette below
shots.action: a colossal squid silhouette glides under the tiny swimmer

shots.line: You tell no one. You just hold the compass tighter.
shots.environment: inside helmet, fogged glass
shots.action: wooden fingers clench the brass compass, needle trembling

shots.line: Year sixteen. You pilot the cargo sub alone through the trench.
shots.environment: cockpit of a small sub, instrument glow
shots.action: teen marionette grips the controls as rock walls rush past the canopy

shots.line: Sonar pings hit things that aren't on any map.
shots.environment: cockpit, green sonar screen
shots.action: sonar screen fills with unknown shapes; the teen leans in

shots.line: You patch a cracked hull with shaking hands.
shots.environment: engine room, spraying leak
shots.action: wooden hands press a sealant patch over a hissing crack

shots.line: The crew starts calling you before they call the captain.
shots.environment: control room, crew turning toward the teen
shots.action: crew members turn toward the teen as an alarm board blinks

shots.line: Year thirty. The surface sends word: the station is shutting down.
shots.environment: command deck, red alert light, message on screen
shots.action: adult marionette reads a glowing evacuation notice, red light washing the deck

shots.line: Everyone you know packs for a world you've only seen in pictures.
shots.environment: docking bay crowded with crates and departing crew
shots.action: crew carry crates toward an escape capsule; the marionette stands still among them

shots.line: You're terrified of the sky. It has no ceiling.
shots.environment: small cabin, faded photo of a sunny beach
shots.action: the marionette stares at a faded beach photo, joints trembling

shots.line: The last night, you sleep beside the porthole one more time.
shots.environment: nursery porthole from day one, jellyfish glowing
shots.action: the adult curls by the same porthole, jellyfish drifting past

shots.line: Year thirty-one. The capsule rises for hours through darkness.
shots.environment: capsule interior, black water outside
shots.action: the marionette grips a seat strap as pressure gauges spin

shots.line: The water slowly turns from black to blue.
shots.environment: capsule rising through gradient water, light rays above
shots.action: the capsule ascends as the water lightens from black to blue

shots.line: The hatch opens. The light is so bright you close your eyes.
shots.environment: hatch opening, blinding sunlight
shots.action: sunlight floods the bead eyes; the marionette raises a hand to shield them

shots.line: And for the first time, the compass needle stops moving.
shots.environment: the compass in the palm under open sky
shots.action: the brass needle settles and stops, pointing straight up

shots.line: You finally reached the place it was pointing to all along. Home.
shots.environment: capsule floating on calm sunlit ocean, open sky
shots.action: the marionette stands on the capsule holding the compass to the sky as gulls circle
